<description>
An orphan that enters the mempool other than through peer relay (e.g. by
RPC) stays in the orphanage, so Find1P1CPackage can pick it as the child
of a reconsiderable parent, and package evaluation then reports it as
MEMPOOL_ENTRY, which hits Assume(false). Have Find1P1CPackage erase such
children from the orphanage and skip them.
</description>

diff --git a/src/net_processing.cpp b/src/net_processing.cpp
index 8ab654dbdc..612ba5365e 100644
--- a/src/net_processing.cpp
+++ b/src/net_processing.cpp
@@ -3473,7 +3473,8 @@ void PeerManagerImpl::ProcessPackageResult(const node::PackageToValidate& packag
                 }
                 case MempoolAcceptResult::ResultType::MEMPOOL_ENTRY:
                 {
-                    // AlreadyHaveTx() should be catching transactions that are already in mempool.
+                    // AlreadyHaveTx() catches a parent that is already in the mempool, and
+                    // Find1P1CPackage() skips children that are.
                     Assume(false);
                     break;
                 }
diff --git a/src/node/txdownloadman_impl.cpp b/src/node/txdownloadman_impl.cpp
index fe3f7a882a..d970767284 100644
--- a/src/node/txdownloadman_impl.cpp
+++ b/src/node/txdownloadman_impl.cpp
@@ -314,6 +314,12 @@ std::optional<PackageToValidate> TxDownloadManagerImpl::Find1P1CPackage(const CT
     // of children that replace each other, this helps us accept the highest feerate (probably the
     // most recent) one efficiently.
     for (const auto& child : cpfp_candidates_same_peer) {
+        // An orphan can be in the mempool if it got there other than through peer relay (e.g. by
+        // RPC), as nothing removes it from the orphanage then.
+        if (m_mempool.exists(child->GetWitnessHash())) {
+            m_orphanage->EraseTx(child->GetWitnessHash());
+            continue;
+        }
         Package maybe_cpfp_package{ptx, child};
         if (!RecentRejectsReconsiderableFilter().contains(GetPackageHash(maybe_cpfp_package)) &&
             !RecentRejectsFilter().contains(child->GetHash().ToUint256())) {
diff --git a/test/functional/p2p_orphan_handling.py b/test/functional/p2p_orphan_handling.py
index a25c93cd1f..b6e521dbe4 100755
--- a/test/functional/p2p_orphan_handling.py
+++ b/test/functional/p2p_orphan_handling.py
@@ -839,6 +839,30 @@ class OrphanHandlingTest(BitcoinTestFramework):
         assert orphan["txid"] in final_mempool
         assert tx_replacer_C["txid"] in final_mempool
 
+    @cleanup
+    def test_orphan_in_mempool(self):
+        self.log.info("Test that an orphan in the mempool is removed from the orphanage when found as the child of a 1p1c package")
+        node = self.nodes[0]
+        parent = self.wallet.create_self_transfer(fee_rate=0)
+        child = self.wallet.create_self_transfer(utxo_to_spend=parent["new_utxo"])
+        parent_bad_wit = malleate_tx_to_invalid_witness(parent)
+        peer = node.add_p2p_connection(PeerTxRelayer())
+
+        # A version of the parent with another witness is rejected for its feerate (reconsiderable),
+        # and the child is stored as an orphan.
+        peer.send_and_ping(msg_tx(parent_bad_wit))
+        peer.send_and_ping(msg_tx(child["tx"]))
+        assert tx_in_orphanage(node, child["tx"])
+
+        # The child enters the mempool by RPC, which does not remove it from the orphanage.
+        assert_equal(node.submitpackage([parent["hex"], child["hex"]])["package_msg"], "success")
+        assert tx_in_orphanage(node, child["tx"])
+
+        # The same parent version is paired with the orphan, which turns out to be in the mempool.
+        peer.send_and_ping(msg_tx(parent_bad_wit))
+        assert not tx_in_orphanage(node, child["tx"])
+        assert child["txid"] in node.getrawmempool()
+
     def run_test(self):
         self.nodes[0].setmocktime(int(time.time()))
         self.wallet_nonsegwit = MiniWallet(self.nodes[0], mode=MiniWalletMode.RAW_P2PK)
@@ -860,6 +884,7 @@ class OrphanHandlingTest(BitcoinTestFramework):
         self.test_announcers_before_and_after()
         self.test_parents_change()
         self.test_maximal_package_protected()
+        self.test_orphan_in_mempool()
 
 
 if __name__ == '__main__':
